source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-DWR3SS1 Top Control Dishwasher Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect the power supply to the dishwasher.

steps.title: E9 behavior
steps.body: E9 logs when any button is held longer than 30 seconds.
steps.sourceExcerpt: when some buttons have been pressed over 30 seconds, the dishwasher will warning for E9.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service test mode entered. Continue with component checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After service test entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Control panel / touchpad
steps.body: Inspect control panel for stuck, damaged, or moisture-swollen keys. Disconnect power and verify keys release freely.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect control panel for stuck, damaged, or moisture-swollen keys. Disconnect power and verify keys release freely.

steps.title: Retest operation
steps.body: Restore power. Press each touchpad key briefly — none should hold continuously.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. Press each touchpad key briefly — none should hold continuously.

steps.title: Replace control panel
steps.body: Replace control panel assembly (UI board is bonded to panel).
steps.oemOutcome: Replace control panel assembly (UI board is bonded to panel).

steps.title: Control panel verified
steps.body: No stuck keys — E9 should not return.
steps.oemOutcome: No stuck keys — E9 should not return.
